data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net strengthening of prior year reserves of $2.438 million in 2022, representing a 1.32% deterioration against the opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was influenced by economic inflation and geopolitical events, which led to an uplift in reserves. The 2020 year of account closed with a loss of $17.2 million. The syndicate also noted the impact of the Russian invasion of Ukraine and Hurricane Ian in 2022, although its exposure to Hurricane Ian was modest, and the ongoing effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and Brexit on inflation.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $2.438 million is stated as a net figure in the report, as no gross figure was explicitly available. The claims development table is distorted by a significant External RITC of $101.597 million, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development.
